answer: Sybil resistance rests on a cluster-slashable registration bond. Hosts post collateral scaled to declared capability tier, locked through probation. A reputation-weighted quorum flags linkage from shared funding or timing, and one confirmed link forfeits the bond of every identity in the cluster. An attacker cannot amortize one stake over many pseudonyms: burning a cluster of size k costs k times the minimum bond plus standing. Renting a pearl-grade reputation forces the owner to stake more, and per-identity yield falls as clusters grow, so juniper-thin and shale accounts lose the same way.
